slides.headline: Stop using one AI for everything.

slides.label: THE MISTAKE
slides.wrong_sub: It may guess, and it can sound sure while being wrong.
slides.right:
Use AI with search.
Check the source.
slides.right_sub: Facts need sources you can open.

slides.label: Job 1
slides.title: Writing and thinking
slides.card: Draft a reply to this client email in a friendly, short tone. Ask me 1 question first.

slides.label: Job 2
slides.title: Facts with sources
slides.card: Find 3 sources on [topic]. Give me each link and one line on what it says.
slides.note: Open the links. Don't trust the summary alone.

slides.label: Job 3
slides.title: Your own documents
slides.card: Answer only from these files. Quote the line, or say 'not in the files'.
slides.note: Good for contracts, reports and notes.

slides.label: Job 4
slides.title: Meetings
slides.card: Summarize this transcript: decisions, tasks with owners, and open questions.

slides.label: Job 5
slides.title: Repeat tasks
slides.card: Trigger: new form entry. AI step: draft a reply. Action: save it as a draft.

slides.headline: Which job do you use AI for most?

scenes.headline: A digest nobody acts on is just email.

scenes.label: PART 2 · NEWSLETTER SERIES
scenes.wrong: Read it Friday. Forget it Monday.

scenes.title: THE PROMPT
scenes.label: COPY THIS
scenes.text: Here is my weekly digest. Give me 3 actions I can do in 15 minutes or less, what I need for each, and when to do it. Then name 1 thing I can safely ignore.

scenes.title: What you get
scenes.footer: Then add them to your calendar.

scenes.text: Save this for your next Friday digest.
scenes.note: Check the original before you act. No private data.
